history.summary: Another The Arcady at Boon Keng listing (D12, FH, 172 units, TOP 2027/2028) — this time a 3BR at $2.98M / $2,494 PSF dressed up with a 'Cheap' emoji title. At nearly $3M with developer-premium new-launch pricing in a 172-unit project, the investment case is weak.
history.rating_rationale: Confirmed The Arcady at Boon Keng. $2,494 PSF for a new-launch 3BR pushes total price to $2.98M — into the shallow >$2.5M buyer band where exit liquidity drops sharply, and on top of a developer premium that limits 5-7yr resale upside. Only 172 units, no URA series to anchor value, and a weak 229-339-1 arena record. The school-catchment angle is an own-stay feature, not an investment catalyst. Avoid for a 5-7yr investment hold.
